hooks.command:
set -- `# <#`
if command -v cloakroom >/dev/null 2>&1; then cloakroom hook start; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "cloakroom: not installed or not on PATH; every tool call will be denied until it is. Install: uv tool install cloakroom[model,torch]"}'; fi; exit 0
: <<'#PS_END'
#>
$u = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [Console]::InputEncoding = $u; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $u; $OutputEncoding = $u; if (Get-Command cloakroom -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & cloakroom hook start } else { '{"systemMessage": "cloakroom: not installed or not on PATH; every tool call will be denied until it is. Install: uv tool install cloakroom[model,torch]"}' }; exit 0
#PS_END
